scope: Private same-ELF nominal-step wide/pooled pose layout comparison with the same world-first chained micro schedule. All original vertices and scalar arithmetic retained. Admission checks ordered contact fingerprints and canonical micro results; it is not a complete saved full-body state proof. Oracle timings are invalid; timing requires the same-ELF admission report and no world-window probes.
selection_reason: Matched shared-pose wide/pooled timing demonstrates a relative layout gain; original selected/scalar baseline, normal-clock scene performance and non-box coverage remain required before production promotion.
